description: Source documents for eSim-Cloud RAG pipeline. Add markdown files to rag/source/ then run: python manage.py ingest_docs
notes: Place .md documentation files in the source_directory before running ingest_docs.
Suggested sources: eSim Cloud RTD (esim-cloud.readthedocs.io), in-repo docs/, README.md
After adding files run: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec django python manage.py ingest_docs --reset
